thread:
jamie: Kicking off a 2-week Demo Labs cohort to test starter credit allocation + prompt-template variants. Goal: lift week-1 activation by ~15%. Thoughts on cohort size, routing, and measurement? :rocket:

maya: Love it. Recommend 120 seats, split 60/60 A/B. 50 starter credits each. Route high-intent signups to office hours if they hit 3 requests in 24h. @aj can you confirm routing tags?

aj: Can do. We'll tag inbound with utm_campaign=demo_labs and route to growth pipeline -> default 'warm'. If a user makes >3 requests in first 24h mark as 'hot' and push to office-hours queue. Quick Q: how are we surfacing the prompt templates in-app?

jamie: Prompt sets: A = curated "Starter Templates" + 1 onboarding nudge; B = open "Playbook" with examples and editable prompts. Activation metric = any generation with >10 tokens + positive 'useful' eval (manual binary for cohort).

leah: Webinar/office-hours timing: propose 3 live sessions week-of (NA morning, EU midday, APAC evening). Promo post goes live Tue morning, registration page + calendar invites.

nate: Creative plan: short carousel + 30s demo clip. Benchmark narrative: "From zero to a useful summary in under 2 minutes" — we'll show time-to-first-success and cost-per-activation baseline.

samir: Ops notes: set Dedicated pool cap to 20 GPUs for peak demo hours to keep p99 < 400ms. Add fallback to a quantized model variant when capacity > 80% to preserve latency SLOs. Also enable prefix caching for the starter prompts.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Autoscale policy updated for project/demo-labs (min=2, max=20). Alerts configured: p95 latency > 600ms -> paging.

maya: @samir can we also pre-warm the pool for 30 minutes before each office-hour slot?

samir: Yep, adding a pre-warm task. Will also add a short warmup script to prime common KV keys.

aj: Draft experiment config below — quick and dirty for infra/analytics handoff:

```json
{ "experiment_id": "demo_labs_v1", "cohort_size": 120, "arms": { "A": { "prompt_pack": "starter_templates", "credits": 50 }, "B": { "prompt_pack": "playbook_open", "credits": 50 } }, "routing": { "utm_campaign": "demo_labs", "hot_threshold": 3 }, "metrics": ["week1_activation", "cpl", "webinar_attendance"] }
```

jamie: Perfect. Dashboard needs: 7-day activation, CPL, webinar attendance, and delta A vs B. @leah can you mock a Console dashboard with these widgets?

leah: On it. I'll wire up a demo dashboard and share the link. Also writing 3 short reminder emails: registration confirm, 24h reminder, and post-webinar follow-up with credit expiration at 7 days.

nate: Creative checklist: hero screenshot, two CTAs (Join Demo Labs / Claim Starter Credits), 30s clip edits. I'll have assets by EOD Monday.

maya: :thumbsup: Timeline recap — soft-launch to 120 seed users Monday, public registration opens Tue, first office hour Wed.

jamie: Action items: @aj implement routing tags + analytics hooks, @samir pre-warm + pool cap + caching, @leah dashboard + email flows, @nate creative assets by EOD Mon. I'll draft landing copy and registration flow. Stand-up Friday 10:00 to review. Thanks all!
